svg.title: The eight levels of an installation
svg.desc: Drawn by docs/book/figures.py from the code of Omni-Compass.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(95%,95%,94%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Level 0. Verify the software, touching nothing: python3 verify.py

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: pass: VERIFICATION: PASS

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(95%,95%,94%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Level 1. Watch, read-only: every decision logged, none written

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: pass: zero writes, and readings your operators agree with

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,93%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Level 2. The pods, through your own autoscalers

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: pass: p95, p99 and failures never behind native, in paired runs

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(65%,50%,12%); stroke:none;

g.text: WRITES

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,93%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Level 3. The machines, through the release gate and the verdict

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: pass: fewer machines in service, no LOSS on any service gauge

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(65%,50%,12%); stroke:none;

g.text: WRITES

rect.style: stroke: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,93%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(4%,12%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Level 4. The replica decision itself (an option, not a step)

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(40%,40%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: pass: as level 3

text.style: font-family: 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(65%,50%,12%); stroke:none;

g.text: take them in order: the OFF switch works at every level,
